title: lithocarpus reflexus
intro: Lithocarpus reflexus, commonly known as the reflexed footnut, is a species of evergreen tree native to China and Southeast Asia. It is a medicinal plant that has been used for centuries to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including the reduction of inflammation, improvement of cardiovascular health, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus reflexus include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its medicinal properties and potential applications.
